title: jamesonia sellowiana
intro: Jamesonia sellowiana, commonly known as the "Queen of the Andes," is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Jamesonia sellowiana include wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
